You need a big dream. You also can't live in a dream world.

Kevin Trudeau explains that people with huge imaginations dream on a large scale. He points to Walt Disney, who was flat broke while he talked about building a whole city.

He says Disney could dream big, and that is very different from living in a fantasy. In Kevin's words, if you only dream and never act, you are delusional.

Where in your life do you dream big and still take real steps?
